name: opam

scripts.checksum_source: locally-pinned upstream script at fixed commit

resources.checksum_source: locally-computed-pin from official HTTPS release; not independently authenticated publisher checksum

smoke:
printf 'opam-version: "2.0"
name: "offline-demo"
version: "1.0.0"
synopsis: "Local offline package"
maintainer: "test@example.com"
authors: "Example"
license: "MIT"
homepage: "https://example.com"
bug-reports: "https://example.com/issues"
' > "$HOME/offline-demo.opam"; "$OFFLINE_PREFIX/bin/opam" lint "$HOME/offline-demo.opam" | grep -q Passed
notes: Preserves embedded upstream SHA-512 verification. Manager only: no OCaml compiler, package repository, switch or package downloads are included. Wrapper supplies installation directory through installer stdin.
Upstream installer is fetched at build time from a pinned commit. No upstream script snapshot is vendored in the skill.
